xmldoc.short_description: Converts xml Nelson help files to html.

syntax.syntax_item: status = xmldoctohtml(source_dirs, destination_dir, main_title, overwrite, index_dirs)

param_input_item.param_description: a cell of string: list of xml filenames.
a string: title of main index.
a logical: force overwrite if file destination already exists
a cell of string (optional): XML help roots of the other modules whose pages may be linked, used to resolve <link linkend="${module}name">.

param_output_item.param_description: a logical: files generated or not.

description.p: xmldoctohtml converts xml Nelson help files to html.

Links declared with the link element in chapter_description are retained in the generated chapter summary. A linkend such as guide or nested/guide is relative to the module root; ${module}guide and {module}guide select a module explicitly. Targets are XML page paths without the extension, keywords or aliases: every link is resolved from the keyword index of source_dirs and index_dirs and points to the real page, even in a chapter sub-directory or when the file name differs from the keyword. Unresolved links are reported as warnings.

history_item.history_description: index_dirs input argument: links resolved from the keyword index.
